30 minutes (plus the 5 min waits if you get caught)

A band of thieves stole a sacred casket from the nomads. {npc:Muhad}, the nomads' leader, asks you to sneak into the thieves' hideout, beneath Ankrahmun, and recover it. It is a stealth mission: you must not make noise or be seen. You earn 50 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}, a {item:Jewel Case (Nomad)}, the scroll {item:The Sacred Casket (Book)} and 2 {item:Small Sapphire|Small Sapphires}.
Some thieves stole something very valuable from the nomads.
in a box inside the hideout
Before handing in the mission to Muhad, take the {item:Casket} out of your backpack (leave it in the depot or on the ground next to you). That way you receive the reward and keep the casket.
Study the hideout map carefully before going in: the right path avoids all the sounds and windows.

The {wiki:Nomad Cave} is beneath the mountains between **Darashia** and **Ankrahmun**, just east of the passage to Darashia. Since you have already done the {wiki:Arito's Task Quest}, use the secret entrance: in the desert, near the official entrance, dig the hidden hole with the {item:Shovel} (sometimes you need to dig several times on the right tile), go down and pass through the door inside, which only opens for those who have completed Arito's Task.

Go to the **Nomad Cave** and talk to {npc:Muhad}. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:arito}, {key:yes} and {key:yes}. He tells you that the thieves have their hideout in Ankrahmun and that the entrance is a pillar with a hidden mechanism: the falcon eye symbol.
To leave the Nomad Cave, use the path behind Muhad, as he tells you, so you don't get into trouble with the nomads.
Leaving the Nomad Cave and going to Ankrahmun
Go up the stairs behind {npc:Muhad} (the back exit) and use the {item:Rope} to climb to the surface through the hole in the desert. From there, walk **south** through the desert to **Ankrahmun**.
In **Ankrahmun**, go to the {item:Sandstone Pillar (Quest)|sandstone pillar}, **north-west of the temple**. Use the pillar: you fall into a basement 2 floors below ground level (point 1 on the map).
Map of the thieves' hideout with the numbered points and the green path
Inside the hideout, follow the **green path** on the map and obey these rules:
Stepping in puddles of {item:Beer|beer}, water or {item:Milk|milk}
Stepping on planks or piles of wood on the floor or leaning against the wall
Walking in front of a window or too close to it

If you slip up, a {creature:Thief (creature)|Thief} appears saying "That was a BIG mistake!" and, if you move, "You are exposed, run for your life!". You are teleported to the pillar with the message "You barely escaped the thieves..." and you have to wait **5 minutes** before going in again.

Follow the green path to point **2**. Wait for the {creature:Tiger|tiger} to pass north, beyond the wall (point 3), and only then pull the lever. You are teleported to the other side of the locked door.
Make sure the tiger is really in the room at point 3 before you pull the lever.
At point **4**, put out the light on the wall.
The **purple line** on the map takes you to a box with 2 {item:Small Sapphire|Small Sapphires}. Go and get them.
At point **5**, pull the lever to close the tapestries above the thief's bed.

This is the hard part. On the map, the black dot on the wall to the **south** is a window. Next to point 6 there are crates and a large amphora. Put **3 crates in a row** along the black line and place the **large amphora on top of the middle crate** (the one in front of the window). If the amphora isn't there, put 3 parcels or boxes in its place. Then continue along the path.
The right way to place the crates and the amphora

At point **7** is the dresser with the quest item. Open the drawers and pick up the {item:Bag|bag}: it contains the {item:Casket} and a scroll ({item:The Sacred Casket (Book)}) with a text about the casket.
Run as fast as you can to point **8**, to the teleport next to a bamboo bookshelf. It takes you back to Ankrahmun.
If you take too long, 3 {creature:Thief (creature)|Thieves} spawn and you are teleported out.
If you want to keep the {item:Casket}, leave it in the depot or on the ground next to you before talking to Muhad. He gives you the reward anyway.

Go back to the Nomad Cave and say {key:hi} and {key:mission} (or {key:casket}) to {npc:Muhad}. You receive the reward. To get there, dig the secret hole in the desert again with the {item:Shovel} and enter through the back door; at the end, leave the same way with the {item:Rope}.
If you don't have the casket with you, Muhad says the nomads followed you and took it back, but you actually keep it.
This quest is part of the {wiki:Tibia Tales}.
